mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment consistently reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is negative or insignificant (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, causing investors to reduce equity exposure and generate negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and INDPRO fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases (i.e., 60-day returns are positive in >40% of such instances).

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 100,000 monthly jobs indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The positive correlation between PAYEMS growth and SPX 5-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 650,000 units, it signals a contraction in the residential construction sector that reduces overall economic activity and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST is below 650.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) combined with a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a policy-induced slowdown in the housing market, which reduces consumer confidence and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and rising FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0), manufacturing activity is contracting, which signals a weakening economy and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO is below 95.0.
